Until the end of 2023, Lumen Valley Instruments used an earlier refund rule. This earlier rule was retired on 1 January 2024 and no longer applies to new orders.

Every instrument is packed in a foam-lined box with a moisture sachet. Thermal probes with a cable longer than 3 metres are coiled and fixed with a paper band before boxing.
